correctness.rationale: Freeness identifies End(F2) with F2^2, and each image is the subalgebra generated by the chosen ordered pair. The verifier exhaustively closes all 9216 pairs under complement, meet, and join, with no timeout or sampling, and obtains the stated rank counts. A separate center-factor argument proves Aut_OML(F2) ≅ D8 × S4 and order 192, independently confirming the number of surjective endomorphisms.
